name: Nele Veronica Koestler
headline: Co-Founder RADICE & Unternehmerin Gartencenter Köstler
summary:
I thrive on spending my time with inspiring, energizing people and am deeply excited about shaping the future.
I’m passionate about entrepreneurial mindsets, dynamic teams, and helping high-performing individuals unlock their potential.

After studying Philosophy, Economics and Digital Technology Management in Munich and New York City, I had the privilege to build ventures from scratch — first with ROCKET INTERNET’s WestwingNow, then transitioning to the B2B SaaS world at Personio.
Today, I’m the Co-Founder of RADICE Sleep — building a modern platform for sleep and mindfulness.

In parallel, I’m leading our family-owned business in the traditional production sector — bridging heritage and innovation every day.
As an entrepreneur, mother of two and facilitator, I know how to integrate business, family and personal growth — and I love creating spaces where people feel safe to grow, connect and shape their own future.

I believe in leadership that blends ambition with empathy — because that’s how you turn ideas into reality, and values into impact.

positions.title: Co-Founder at RADICE Sleep
positions.description:
RADICE is designed for the woman who has seen the world but is never tired of the now nor the new. Sometimes wild, unpredictable, sometimes soft and blissful. Her stories and achievements are a source of inspiration. She gains energy from encounters with new and different souls, landscapes, and vibrant talks during the blue hour. Elegant, yet rebellious she wears her sleepwear outside, savoring every dawn. 

We are the fashion label for the modern, independent woman. We design classic pyjamas with a modern twist  - produced with the finest silk. We source sustainably and produce every piece with delicate care.
